Players Committee card image of [[ARC-170 Starfighter]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Opponent may not 'react' to or from here. During battle, if about to be lost before the damage segment, lost at end of battle instead.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c241f88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/arc170starfighter.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/arc170starfighter.png] as of commit c241f88 “vset14” (18 March 2021).
